How it plays

Accidentally become an Islamic trivia expert

1

Draw the word

Pull a card and get your word. You're the only one who sees it.

2

Give smart clues

Describe it to your team without saying the guess word or the 5 forbidden ones.

3

Beat the clock

Your team races the timer. Get it right, pass the deck, argue about the rules.

Features

Chaos, but Halal

30 second rounds. Zero chill.
